workspace: expected active uncommitted integration; source hashes below, not attributed to HEAD commit contents
review_scope: Independent read-only shared key/protocol/client lifecycle review. Native owned sources remained frozen except parent-authorized four equivalent Clippy fixes, which are separately recorded in native server author handoff. No changes to reviewed files.

checks.name: key construction
checks.evidence: Canonical private string and FromStr/serde validation preserve native/physical/virtual namespace separation, exact usb- lowercase64 fingerprint and fixed profiles.

checks.name: metadata frame bounds
checks.evidence: 4B BE length is checked before allocation; request<=4096 and mapping<=8192; zero/oversized frames rejected.

checks.name: metadata schemas
checks.evidence: Prelude and mapping use strict serde, explicit schema1, known operations and bounded device key/BusId types.

checks.name: mapping cardinality
checks.evidence: Custom mapping visitor stops at16; duplicate stable keys and duplicate current BusIDs rejected.

checks.name: mapping descriptor correlation
checks.evidence: discover requires equal mapping/DEVLIST lengths and consumes mapping entries by BusID, rejecting unmatched addresses; list order is not authorization.

checks.name: discovery response bounds
checks.evidence: Standard read_devlist bounds devices/interfaces and rejects duplicate BusIDs, malformed strings/version/opcode/status; shared management total deadline remains5s.

checks.name: selected configuration key
checks.evidence: select_and_import selects config.device by equality from authenticated catalog and creates a new authenticated import connection; no CLI endpoint/key/certificate override.

checks.name: IMPORT prelude address binding
checks.evidence: import_device writes selected stable key plus selected BusID standard frame, and checks every fixed descriptor field and interface count against selected metadata.

checks.name: IMPORT exact stream boundary
checks.evidence: Reads exactly8B reply header plus312B successful device header with AsyncReadExt.read_exact; no BufReader/lookahead; returns same owned generic stream. TLS internal pending application bytes stay owned by same ClientStream.

checks.name: interface provenance
checks.evidence: IMPORT wire carries count, not tuples: actual.interfaces is explicitly copied from authenticated catalog; later native helper enumeration contract separately checks actual imported interface classes. No claim IMPORT authenticates absent tuple bytes.

checks.name: server exact request parsing
checks.evidence: server::read_management reads exact8/32 fixed fields, checks version/status/opcode, NUL termination and every remaining IMPORT BusID padding byte.

checks.name: server response layout
checks.evidence: Shared devlist/import encoding bounds16 devices and interface counts; successful IMPORT requires metadata and emits fixed device header without interface tuple tail; flush is explicitly caller-owned.

checks.name: client network deadlines
checks.evidence: Outer configured1..120s timeout covers DNS/TCP/TLS/catalog/import; nested5s management deadlines do not remove outer bound.

checks.name: signal registration
checks.evidence: ShutdownSignals installed before config loading/network/helper resources and both Unix SIGINT/SIGTERM tracked; main does not race secure commands against an outer cancellation branch.

checks.name: config work lifetime
checks.evidence: Signal during synchronous trusted config load still awaits actual spawn_blocking task; it owns no USB resource.

checks.name: prehandle cancellation
checks.evidence: Cancelled selection/import drops owned TLS connection; no local kernel attach is committed before helper handle is obtained.

checks.name: accepted handle ownership
checks.evidence: prepare_native_import is awaited outside cancellation select; pending signal is selected before commit operations after handle receipt, so no returned handle is lost by select cancellation.

checks.name: relay ordering
checks.evidence: Take R once, launch TLS-to-R copy task, then commit K; this avoids waiting for kernel enumeration before relay startup.

checks.name: cleanup convergence
checks.evidence: After handle receipt, take_relay error explicitly closes; signal/helper invalidation/commit error/stdout error/relay completion converge to abort+await unfinished copying then handle.close().await. Close failure is propagated and does not emit cleanup_verified.

checks.name: commit cancellation dependency
checks.evidence: Client dropping commit wait relies on the private daemon control actor completing its framed exchange before close; this is the established helper API contract, not cancellation of a kernel syscall.

checks.name: bounded stdout
checks.evidence: EventOutput limits event encoding<65536 and queue2; dedicated std thread owns only stdout/bytes; send/write receipt deadline5s; canceled/inflight output prevents final extra event. Main secure failures avoid synchronous JSON stdout fallback.

checks.name: completion evidence
checks.evidence: disconnected cleanup_verified is emitted only after close success and successful prior operation; branch with uncertain cleanup returns error. Failed/aborted relay is joined instead of merely dropping JoinHandle.

notes.detail: Generic secure parser accepts devnum1..255 and speed1..6, while audited Linux native import accepts actual USB address1..127 and kernel speed1..5. An unsupported discovered entry can therefore be rejected later by helper; this is safe rejection, not evidence of Native SUPER_PLUS or address>127 support.

Legacy response wire_string validates first NUL/string but does not require all response padding after NUL to be zero; read_devlist ignores interface reserved byte. New server request parser is stricter. No claim all response reserved/padding bytes are canonicalized.

No Cargo/rustc/QEMU/socket/USB actions run for this review. Observed source-level tests were read, not executed. No independent assertion of TLS certificate/revocation implementation or real kernel cleanup/pcap/hardware/Phase3 completion.

CLI main owns orderly signals; abrupt process/runtime destruction cannot await close and relies on control EOF plus durable helper state. This review does not call SIGKILL a cooperative cleanup receipt.
